name: Import Probe – Schema 2.0
description: Small two-host lab for exercising the Import Lab File flow. No host ports are mapped, so it should start without stopping at the review screen.
author: Practicum QA

sections.title: Check connectivity
sections.content_markdown:
Both hosts sit on `10.93.1.0/24`: **host-a** is `10.93.1.10`, **host-b** is `10.93.1.20`.

Node addresses are only reachable from *inside* the lab (Docker Desktop keeps lab networks inside its VM), so don't try to ping or ssh them from Windows. Instead, in the **Lab Nodes** table click **Open shell** next to `host-a` — a terminal window opens inside that node — and run:

```
ping -c 3 10.93.1.20
```

Then do the same from `host-b` towards `10.93.1.10`.

tasks.text: Open a shell on host-a with the Open shell button
